answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the kernel of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the oasis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the anchor of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
